subject: eng
title: Unit 1 revision and test
goal: Ти повториш все з Unit 1 (уподобання, розпорядок дня, Present Simple і Present Continuous) і перевіриш себе в тесті.

theory.text: Це повторення розділу Unit 1. Пройдися по короткій пам'ятці, а потім виконай тест — він покаже, що вже добре, а що ще треба потренувати.

theory.title: Present Simple
theory.text:
Звички і факти: I **play**, she **plays**. Заперечення: I **don't** play, she **doesn't** play. Питання: **Do** you play? **Does** she play?
Підказки: every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

theory.title: Present Continuous
theory.text:
Дія зараз: **am / is / are + -ing**. She **is reading**. Заперечення: **isn't reading**. Питання: **Is** she reading?
Підказки: now, at the moment, right now.

theory.title: I like + -ing
theory.text: I like **swimming**. She doesn't like **drawing**. Do you like **dancing**?

items.ex: We go to school by bus.
I go to bed at nine.
I get up at half past seven.

theory.text: Перед тестом: у третій особі однини додавай -s (he plays), після doesn't дієслово без -s (he doesn't play).

exercises.text: I {don't} like swimming. He {doesn't} play chess. {Does} she get up at 7? {Are} you reading now?

items.text: Is she sleeping now? — No, she isn't.
I am go to school every day.
They are playing in the park now.

exercises.text: I get up at seven o'clock every day. Now I am reading a book.

Present Simple: I go to bed at nine.
Present Continuous: We are eating at the moment.

homework.text: My brother {plays} chess every day. He {is playing} chess now. I {don't} like running.
homework.hint: Подивись на слова every day і now.

homework.q: Напиши 4 речення про свій день (що робиш щодня) і про те, що робиш зараз.
homework.sample: I get up at 7 every day. I go to school by bus. I usually do homework at 3. Now I am writing.
